versions.changelog:
Initial release of codeagent-wrapper skill for multi-backend AI code automation.

- Supports Codex, Claude, Gemini, and OpenCode AI backends for code tasks.
- Enables agent presets, skill injection, and structured code prompt orchestration.
- Provides parallel task execution, worktree isolation, and session resume features.
- Auto-detects skills from project files or allows manual override.
- Outputs structured progress updates and supports both single and multi-agent workflows.
